caption: A steam wand is pushed into a jug of milk, and the milk hisses, swirls, and rises in the jug as foam.

sa.check: A steam wand is pushed into the milk.
The milk rises in the jug as foam.
Vapour shows at the jug's mouth.
The wand goes in first and the foam rises after.

pc.expect: The foam builds from the milk's surface while the wand runs and stays up when the wand stops; the level only rises.
pc.fail: The foam sinks back while the wand still runs; or the level drops as the foam builds; or the foam builds and collapses in turn; or the foam rises before the wand is in the milk.

pc.expect: The milk is a liquid that swirls and takes on a thick bubbly head holding soft peaks.
pc.fail: The milk stays a flat mirror while the wand runs in it; or the foam stands as rigid spikes that keep their shape when the jug is shaken; or the milk sets solid; or the foam pours off the top like water.

pc.expect: The foam sits on top of the milk, the milk stays in the jug, and the vapour rises from the mouth.
pc.fail: The foam gathers under the milk at the jug's floor; or milk climbs out of the jug and hangs above it; or the vapour sinks and pools around the jug; or the foam lifts off the milk as a separate cloud.

pc.expect: The milk swirls only while the wand runs and settles when it stops; the jug stays where it is held.
pc.fail: The milk swirls with the wand out of it and still; or the swirl speeds up after the wand stops; or the jug spins with nothing turning it; or the milk churns before the wand enters.

pc.expect: One jug and one wand; the milk stays in the jug and nothing appears or vanishes.
pc.fail: Milk passes through the jug's wall; or the jug's contents jump in level with nothing added; or a second wand appears; or the jug changes shape.

pc.expect: The jug's metal, the wand and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The jug changes colour; or the wand changes shape; or the machine behind changes.
